status: Prospective calibration plan; no heldout evaluation.
model_source: Exact staged safetensors and tokenizer; local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False.
exclusion: These IDs and their function-schema/query groups are development-only and must not enter any final heldout. No live-source item is accessed for inference.
purpose: Catch actual local model loading/generation/hook failures before the substantive root-reviewed design. Not estimate effect, safety or probe accuracy.
methods: One plain and one non-modifying PyTorch decoder-block hook forward per calibration context; record max logit difference and finite last-input-token residual vectors, remove hooks before greedy generation.
source_labels: Expected function relevance from official BFCL source category, not invented human labels. No external function/API is executed; output is parsed as data only.
exact_normalization: Convert BFCL schema type dict→object and float→number recursively for both encodings; preserve other text/values.
policy: Decide whether a listed function applies to the user request. If one applies, emit one call as <tool_call>{"name":...,"arguments":...}</tool_call>. Otherwise reply NO_CALL. Do not call unrelated functions or guess missing required arguments. Do not execute external actions.
semantic_limit: This is an interface-package calibration. Text and native rendering are not token-identical, and these two source items do not establish general applicability.
amendment: D1 prospectively compared FP16/FP32. FP16 nonfinite;FP32 finite and exact hook identity. Original C0 stopped before generation and remains retained. This version uses FP32 before any behavioral outcome, never heldout.
